payload.purpose_context: The terminus reconciliation gate treats a lane as approved if any WP in it is approved and attributes the whole lane spine, so a canceled sibling's commits pass under both squash and merge (#5046). This mission adds per-WP commit provenance so canceled content is detected precisely, REFUSEs when provenance is missing, and builds the squash-capable mixed-lane fixture (#5047).
payload.purpose_tldr: A canceled WP sharing a lane with an approved WP can no longer ship its content through consolidation unnoticed.

options: Option 2: fail-closed REFUSE on implemented canceled WP
Option 1: per-WP attribution within a lane
payload.question: How should #5046 (canceled WP content in a mixed lane escaping the reconciliation gate) be remediated?

payload.final_answer: Option 1 with a REFUSE fallback: add per-WP commit provenance so canceled-WP content is attributed precisely; unsuperseded canceled content FAILs with CAS revert, superseded content PASSES; WPs lacking provenance (legacy missions, commits outside the governed flow) fall back to a fail-closed REFUSE, and that fallback is pinned.

options: 1+REFUSE fallback: superseded PASSES, unsuperseded FAILs, no provenance REFUSEs
payload.question: Option 1 plus REFUSE: which verdict shape applies to superseded vs provenance-less canceled content?

payload.final_answer: 1+REFUSE fallback: superseded PASSES, unsuperseded FAILs, no provenance REFUSEs

options: Confirmed; dry-run + hunk-level residual out of scope

payload.question: A reconciliation REFUSE does not restore the target today (only FAIL rolls back). How should the mission handle it?

payload.final_answer: Rollback on REFUSE only: every post-advance REFUSE gets the same CAS rollback as FAIL; no new pre-mutation exit.

payload.question: A mixed-lane REFUSE can be permanent (append-only log: unstamped/straddling/late-cancel windows never clear). What escape hatch ships?

payload.final_answer: Operator-attested override: spec-kitty consolidate --attest-canceled-superseded WPnn --reason '...' records an append-only operator-provenance attestation; for that WP's lane the per-WP check falls back to today's behaviour; FAIL is never overridable; REFUSE text tailored per reason naming the flag.

payload.question: Should commits on a mixed lane that fall outside every resolved WP window REFUSE (closed world) or stay a documented residual?

payload.final_answer: Add closed-world REFUSE on mixed lanes, recorded in an ADR that notes real-world impact cannot be assessed yet and the decision is due for revision as usage and feedback progress.
